text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp, gulp, gulp*—...
Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp had begun.
Right from the start,
Air Messiah was in top form,
and training was progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today wrapped up nicely as well,
leaving only the cool-down.
If there was one thing lingering on my mind,
it was—
choice_data_list: Do you think you can get some good...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer camp, where you sleep,
what you eat,
and your daily rhythm all change.
Amidst all that,
I was concerned about whether she was truly
able to relax.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
About that, actually...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Truth be told,
I haven't quite found a fulfilling way to
do so.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In this environment,
about all I have access to are e-books.
So in terms of engaging in active rest,
I haven't managed much.
choice_data_list: I see. Hopefully you can find some...
I see. It'd be great if you could ...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We still have plenty of time left in
the camp,
so I hope to come across something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even as I said those words to her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I realized I hadn't found a way to relax,
either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of an unfamiliar environment,
dealing with different staff,
and planning training regimens tailored
specifically for the camp—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could already tell the toll would inevitably
catch up to me,
piling up into serious exhaustion...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sat down on the sofa and pulled out my
smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just to pass the time,
I opened a video app and started
scrolling.
Then—one video caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Moss terrariums—
commonly known as mosseriums.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I cultivate them in my room on a regular
basis.
Today,
I came here in search of new decorations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remembering our previous outing,
I looked back down at my phone.
—I might have just come up with a great
idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I sent Air Messiah a message,
then hurried off to buy the necessary
supplies.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
So, Trainer,
what was it you wanted to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A suggestion?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nodded and showed her what I'd bought.
Plastic containers with lids, a utility knife,
craft glue, and other crafting tools.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: This is—
choice_data_list: Well, how about... we try making a...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My voice shrank a bit.
I wasn't used to making suggestions like
this,
nor did I consider myself particularly
artistic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Would she even be interested—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...
Do you mean using the sand from this very
beach?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is an experience unique to this
place.
I would be very interested.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Like with mosseriums,
I quite enjoy hands-on crafts.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Would you please teach me how to make one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding back my excitement,
I began explaining the steps I'd learned
from the video.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh... whoosh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rhythmic sound of incoming and outgoing
waves.
The scent of the sea breeze brushing against
our cheeks.
The air carrying the quiet fervor unique to
a summer night. And then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The hole for the sand to pass through is
complete.
Next,
we attach these two pieces with the adhesive...
like so.
choice_data_list: 'll hold it steady so it doesn't slip.
I'll hold it down so it doesn't slip.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Ah, yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quiet,
scattered words exchanged between us.
A natural, serene conversation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is taking shape nicely.
Next,
for the sand...
let us collect some from right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pleasant sound echoed as the sand trickled
smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I often spent time like this with my
mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Baking sweets together, knitting,
tending to plants.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My mother was always so meticulous in
everything she did,
and watching her only deepened my respect
for her—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be like her, and so...
I learned to approach everything with
earnestness and steady dedication.
choice_data_list: I see. That makes a lot of sense.
I see. That explains a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aspects of her personal life that never came
up in regular conversation
were naturally unfolding before me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, though—there were times when I wanted
to try bold experiments of my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Such as impulsively putting black beans into
cookies, among other things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems her penchant for being
impulsive hasn't changed much since
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the summer sky—
the two of us continued crafting side by
side for a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —It is finished.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The gentle sound of the sand flowing is so
soothing...
This has become a wonderful keepsake.
choice_data_list: Yeah, for me too. Thanks for joini...
Yeah, me too. Thanks for crafting ...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all mine. Thanks to you,
I have spent the most fulfilling restful
time since summer camp began.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Words that made me happier than anything.
Hearing that alone
made me genuinely glad that I had suggested
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that,
summer camp came to a safe and successful
close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And we returned to our daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In my room,
the cactus bought on our previous trip
and the hourglass crafted by the sea sit
side by side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time I look at them,
a warm feeling washes over me—
and my desire to support Air Messiah grows
stronger than ever.
